description:
Grayson Miller’s life goal is to find his soulmate. A fortune-teller told him that his destiny lies with “someone connected to fire, with a big heart.”

Shortly afterwards, Grayson lost consciousness after encountering an Extreme Omega firefighter amidst a blaze!
When Grayson entered the fire station to find him, he ended up getting into a huge fight with firefighter Dane, and the two became entangled...
